Anvil Sound

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. A room built for tracking drums, in a former grain store with a ceiling high enough to be worth the heating bill.

Two live rooms, a stone chamber, and a console that has been in continuous service since 1978 and is maintained by the person who originally commissioned it.

Rates

Day rates include an engineer. We do not charge separately for setup, because setup is most of what makes a record sound like anything.
